messages.author: b2e95be61587b660
messages.subject: Pie chart slice customization
parts:
Is it possible to customize where I want the pie slices to be in this code?  I would like the "Carbon" fraction slice to be on the "positive X axis" of the circle - or to rephrase, horizontal on the right.  I want this slice to open up to another pie chart in my design program so it would be ideal to change it's location to the right instead up in the upper right quadrant.



library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

fraction <- c("Biomass", "Carbon","Water")
my_data <- data.frame(
  fraction = factor(fraction, fraction),
  percentage = c(13, 10, 77))
y_breaks <- cumsum(my_data$percentage) - my_data$percentage/2
y_labels <- c("Biomass","Water")
y_percentage = c(13, 10, 77)

p1 <- ggplot(my_data, aes(x = factor(1), y = percentage, fill = fraction)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, colour = "black", stat = "identity") +
  guides(fill = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.70, y = y_breaks,
                label = y_labels, hjust = c(NA, NA, NA)), size = 7, family="Times") +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.2, y = y_breaks, label = paste0(y_percentage, "%")),
            size = 7, family="Times", colour = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("plum4", "grey","powderblue")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, -0.5, 0),"cm"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank())

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Pie chart slice customization
parts:
coord_polar takes an argument

   start: offset of starting point from 12 o'clock in radians

that affects rotation. Given your label order, this is where Biomass slice starts.

Looks like,

   start=pi/4 * .7

will get close to what you want. To get Carbon on x-axis, it would be asier to reorder the factor and labels so Carbon is first and use start = pi/4

On Saturday, June 13, 2015 at 8:51:45 AM UTC-7, Jaime Ashander wrote:
coord_polar takes an argument

   start: offset of starting point from 12 o'clock in radians

that affects rotation. Given your label order, this is where Biomass slice starts.

Looks like,

   start=pi/4 * .7

will get close to what you want. To get Carbon on x-axis, it would be asier to reorder the factor and labels so Carbon is first and use start = pi/4

On Sat, Jun 13, 2015 at 8:27 AM, Teena Stockert <cmsto...@gmail.com> wrote:
There was an error in the code, sorry.  You may be right about Pie charts, but this is supposed to be a simple visual.  I'll look into alternatives but may not have time, I am on one of those situations where this poster should have been printed yesterday.  yikes.

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)


fraction <- c("Biomass", "Carbon","Water")
